blocks.text: Ionic uses web code. A browser build can be tested before optional native packaging with tools such as Capacitor.
Use an Ionic React starter with its setupIonicReact call and standard Ionic CSS imports. Put these components in App.tsx or App.jsx. The plain playground does not load Ionic styles or components.

blocks.code:
Run the starter's build command.
Preview its production web output.
Test keyboard use and small-screen layout.
Check local state after a reload.
Add native packaging only when the project needs device features.
blocks.title: Build the browser app first

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: The web build checks the same HTML-based app before native packaging.
Keyboard and small-screen tests check actual use, not only whether the compiler produced files.

blocks.text: You get a tested web version before adding platform packaging complexity.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Packaging does not automatically make unsupported browser APIs work everywhere. Test each device feature separately.
